title: AffineSpectrumPullbackSquareCoherence
statement: For affine schemes X,X′,S,S′ with maps f,f′,g,g′ and commutativities g′;f=f′;g and g′₀;f₀=f′₀;g₀, take any M in D(S), N in D(Spec Γ(S)), and k:M→V_S N. Use the forward comparison A and canonical square comparison q from def-pc-affine-spectrum-direct-image-coordinates and lem-pc-scheme-derived-mate-evaluation. The composite Lf′*(Lg*(k);A_g(N)), then A_f′ at Lg₀*N, then V_X′ applied to q(f₀,f′₀,g₀,g′₀)(N), equals q(f,f′,g,g′)(M), then Lg′*Lf*(k), then Lg′*(A_f(N)), then A_g′ at Lf₀*N. No direct images, counits, or base-change mate are used in this statement.

source.place: Remark 20.28.3, counit definition of base change; Tag 0D5S, Lemma 20.27.2, pullback composition

proof.text: Extract associativity for the selected canonical derived pullback composition. For arbitrary commutative side faces, prove that the forward comparison respects composition by postcomposing with an invertible composition comparison, using associativity twice, transporting equalities through the comparison by equality induction, and cancelling inverses. Apply this to the two paths f′;g and g′;f, use h and h0 to identify their forward comparisons, and cancel the top composition comparison. Finally use naturality of the square comparison to move the arbitrary morphism k.

proof_origin.place: M3 second reading: composition associativity and naturality give the prism identity directly.

theorem affineSpectrum_pullback_square_coherence
    {X X' S S' : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsAffine X] [IsAffine X'] [IsAffine S] [IsAffine S']
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (h : g' ≫ f = f' ≫ g)
    (h0 : Spec.map g'.appTop ≫ Spec.map f.appTop =
      Spec.map f'.appTop ≫ Spec.map g.appTop)
    (M : schemeDerivedCategory S) (N : schemeDerivedCategory (Spec Γ(S, ⊤)))
    (k : M ⟶ (derivedPullback S.toSpecΓ).obj N) :
  (derivedPullback f').map
      ((derivedPullback g).map k ≫ (affineSpectrumForwardPullbackIso g).hom.app N) ≫
      (affineSpectrumForwardPullbackIso f').hom.app
        ((derivedPullback (Spec.map g.appTop)).obj N) ≫
      (derivedPullback X'.toSpecΓ).map
        (canonicalDerivedSquareComparison (Spec.map f.appTop) (Spec.map f'.appTop)
          (Spec.map g.appTop) (Spec.map g'.appTop) h0 N) =
    canonicalDerivedSquareComparison f f' g g' h M ≫
      (derivedPullback g').map ((derivedPullback f).map k) ≫
      (derivedPullback g').map ((affineSpectrumForwardPullbackIso f).hom.app N) ≫
      (affineSpectrumForwardPullbackIso g').hom.app
        ((derivedPullback (Spec.map f.appTop)).obj N)
